title: Convert packages.config to PackageReference
description: Moves package references out of packages.config and into <PackageReference> items in the SDK-style .csproj, then runs a restore. This is package-manager-mutating, not file-only, because a real restore against nuget.org (or a private feed) is required to validate the conversion -- the lockfile/package graph can change, and a global NuGet cache is touched.

parameters.name: packages_config_path
parameters.description: Path to the packages.config file being retired.

notes: Per FRD INTEGRITY-8, a failed phase using this template halts and escalates with a compensating-action section naming the lockfile/manifest paths touched, the restore command to re-run, and whether the global package cache was mutated -- there is no automatic reset for this class. Assumes retarget-sdk-style-project has already run for this project.
